properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_project_is_asked_what_its_artifacts_must_be_in.rs — seven cases over the two detectors and the checker property. The one that carries the weight: an acknowledged "none known" on a code-only project stays acknowledged through more code and is re-asked, under a new gap id at higher severity, the day a drawing appears.
properties.name: A project with nothing in it is asked what standard its artifacts must be in; declaring ends it; "none known" holds until a drawing appears and is then asked once more; a drawing that does not say is named and a source that generates it is not; a mirror is not asked
